scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.3%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

tokyo-kanto-rides-tomiura-to-nojimazaki-.story: 843 km from Kimitsu to Chōfu, about 15 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Ōhara, Scenic stretch near Ishige and Annaka. near Ami is the high point. It tops out at about 1,250 m. Much of it runs through woodland.
